methods.title: Evidence-led research
methods.summary: Make claims traceable before synthesizing a recommendation.
methods.approach:
Define the question and exclusions. Collect permitted sources with dates. Extract claims and contradictions before drafting. Separate evidence, inference and unknowns. Review each material claim against its source.
